macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin trades near $78,000 as market steadies after Binance hack
items.summary: Bitcoin gained about 0.81% over 24 hours and traded near $78,000. Avalanche rose 4.34% over the same period, while broader market attention remained focused on the fallout from the Binance exploit.[1]

items.title: Binance says 90% of stolen assets are covered and withdrawals are resuming
items.summary: Binance said it had increased coverage of assets stolen in the roughly $6.3 billion hack to 90%, using more than $6.34 billion in company funds. Withdrawals for selected assets and networks have begun resuming in phases.[2][6]

items.title: North Korea blamed for historic Binance-related crypto theft
items.summary: Blockchain investigators and reporting attributed the attack, which drained more than $6 billion, to North Korean hackers. The incident triggered investigations and intensified efforts to trace and recover the stolen funds.[7][9]

items.title: Crypto industry spends more than $200 million ahead of 2026 U.S. midterms
items.summary: Crypto-related organizations have donated more than $200 million during the 2026 election cycle to influence policy and support favorable digital-asset regulation. Market-structure legislation remains stalled in the Senate.[3]

items.title: Taiwan passes virtual-asset regulatory law
items.summary: Taiwan’s legislature passed the Virtual Asset Service Act, requiring virtual-asset service providers and stablecoin issuers to obtain approval from the Financial Supervisory Commission. Violations can carry prison terms of up to 10 years.[5]

items.title: SEC begins review of novel ETF regulations
items.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission opened a 60-day public-comment period on proposed rules covering novel exchange-traded funds, including crypto and prediction-market funds, potentially setting the stage for rule changes in 2027.[5]

items.title: Solana activates formal on-chain governance system
items.summary: Solana launched its first formal on-chain governance framework. Validators with at least 100,000 staked SOL can submit proposals, while delegators receive override voting power.[5]

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Anthropic introduces Claude Opus 5.5
items.summary: Anthropic announced Claude Opus 5.5, describing it as a model focused on agentic coding and knowledge work. The company says it costs 40% less to run than Claude Opus 5 on typical workloads.

items.title: Google reports first AI inference from TPU in orbit
items.summary: Google said a satellite carrying one of its Tensor Processing Units successfully ran its Gemma 4 model in low Earth orbit and returned the result to Earth. The test is part of Project Suncatcher, which aims to explore solar-powered orbital data centers.

items.title: Alibaba and Apple partner on Qwen-powered Apple Intelligence in China
items.summary: Alibaba announced that its Qwen model will support Apple Intelligence features for Chinese users, including Siri, Writing Tools, and Visual Intelligence. Testing is expected in an iOS developer beta before a wider release in December.

items.title: Mistral reportedly opens Large 4 model weights
items.summary: Mistral was reported to have released the weights for its Large 4 model while retaining a separate license for model services. The move could increase access to the model for researchers and developers.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Phantom Blade Zero launches amid strong reception
items.summary: S-Game’s wuxia action game Phantom Blade Zero released on PlayStation 5 and PC and reportedly drew strong reviews and substantial Steam player numbers, highlighting the growing prominence of China’s AAA game industry.

items.title: Ubisoft details Assassin’s Creed roadmap
items.summary: Ubisoft outlined upcoming franchise plans, including Assassin’s Creed Valhalla’s New Game+ update on November 5, which follows the game surpassing 40 million players, along with broader development and multimedia updates.

items.title: Bend Studio reportedly planning co-op game
items.summary: Sony’s Bend Studio is reportedly developing a third-person cooperative game that is not planned as a live-service title, with a possible reveal and release targeted for 2027.

items.title: Gaming industry braces for GTA VI launch
items.summary: The gaming sector is entering a major transition as publishers avoid competing directly with Grand Theft Auto VI, scheduled for November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Activision released Modern Warfare 4 earlier than usual, apparently positioning it ahead of Rockstar’s blockbuster.

items.title: Netflix developing live-action PUBG series
items.summary: Netflix is reportedly developing a live-action PUBG adaptation with Donald Glover attached to write, direct, produce and star, adding to a growing wave of video game film and television projects.

items.title: Ubisoft reorganizes mobile game operations
items.summary: Ubisoft reportedly placed several mobile studios and brands, including Kolibri, Ketchapp and Hungry Shark, under a reorganized casual mobile division as the company restructures its business.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 reaches post-Phantom Liberty Steam high
items.summary: Cyberpunk 2077 reportedly reached 187,215 concurrent Steam players over the weekend, its highest peak since the Phantom Liberty expansion and Update 2.0 launched in 2023.

items.title: Fan proposes €5 million to revive Prince of Persia remake
items.summary: A fan reportedly proposed more than €5 million to help revive Ubisoft’s canceled Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time Remake, which Ubisoft previously said required more time and investment than it could responsibly commit.
